visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short dark hair and bangs, wearing a grey ruffled long-sleeved shirt and grey leggings, stands on a tiered light-colored padded platform. She holds a small pink bow in her left hand and looks toward the camera with a neutral expression. The background consists of modern light-wood wall shelving and a dark window reflecting the interior lights. (2) The girl begins to descend the padded steps, stepping carefully onto a yellow lower platform and then onto the light wood floor of the living room. She gazes at the camera with curiosity while a pink caption overlay appears at the bottom. A large window behind her shows the reflection of the person filming and the staircase. (3) The child moves into the center of the room and starts twirling and waving her arms in a playful dance. She smiles widely, showing her teeth, and her eyes squint with joy. The living room is well-lit with warm overhead lights and features minimalist wooden furniture and white walls. (4) She stops her dance and stands still, holding the pink bow up with both hands as if inspecting it or showing it to the viewer. Her expression is focused and serious as she looks at the object. The camera remains at her eye level, capturing her from a medium shot distance. (5) The girl resumes her energetic movement, skipping around and flapping her arms like wings. She looks toward the camera and then away, seemingly lost in her own performance. She wears a small purple flower hair clip on her head. (6) The video cuts to a final pink static screen featuring a small cartoon illustration of the girl in the center. Below the character, the white text "POPO'S DAILY LIFE" is displayed in a clean sans-serif font.
